Remark
[completeness descends along submersions and gives a fibration]

Source: petersen:page-0243 ↗ def:pet-ch5-submetry ↗ thm:pet-ch5-hopf-rinow 1. ch5:5.9.37Let $F:(M,g_M)\to (N,g_N)$ be a Riemannian submersion. (1) Show $(N,g_N)$ is complete if $(M,g_M)$ is; (2) show $F$ is a fibration (locally $F^{-1}(U)\cong U\times F^{-1}(p)$) if $(M,g_M)$ is complete, and give a counterexample when it is not.
